components_touched.name: app/changelog/page.tsx
components_touched.summary: Add the 'Back to top' anchor link immediately after <ChangelogList /> inside the <main> element.

deferred_decisions: Specific element ID for the heading (assumed to be the H1 in page.tsx)
rationale:
The previous design (creating a separate component) was explicitly rejected by the reviewer. The requirement is for a single anchor link located within `app/changelog/page.tsx`. 

To implement this:
1. Modify `app/changelog/page.tsx` to include an `<a>` tag (or a button with a click handler) right after `<ChangelogList entries={entries} />`.
2. Ensure the `<h1>` in the header has an `id` (e.g., `id="changelog-heading"`) so the link has a valid target.
3. Apply Tailwind classes for right-alignment (`text-right` or `ml-auto` depending on container) and muted text (`text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400`).
4. To satisfy the "smooth scroll" requirement without a new component, use the CSS property `scroll-behavior: smooth` on the document/html level (if not already present) or use a simple `onClick` handler if a small client-side wrapper is preferred, but the reviewer's intent strongly suggests keeping it as simple as possible. Given "put it inline", an anchor to an ID is the most compliant interpretation.

## Memory writes
- decision: The 'Back to top' link for the changelog page is implemented as an inline anchor within app/changelog/page.tsx rather than a standalone component.

risks.mitigation: Use a standard anchor with an ID or a small client-side 'use client' helper if smooth scroll cannot be achieved with pure CSS/HTML. Given the reviewer's instruction to "put it inline", a standard anchor pointing to the H1's ID is the lowest-impact path.
risks.risk: Smooth scroll behavior might vary by browser if using only an anchor.

swe_constraints: Do NOT create a new BackToTop.tsx component.
The link must be inline in app/changelog/page.tsx.
The link must be right-aligned and use muted styling (zinc-500/400).
The link must follow the last changelog entry in the flow.
